scope: Validate each STT, text and TTS adapter optimization; retain improvements only when correctness and measurement support them.

items.changes: Exclusive language-keyed engine leases, bounded idle retention, drain before reset, discard failed engines.
items.validation: 10 selected speech tests completed. Three identical 4.35-second prerecorded turns transcribed correctly with one initial runtime preparation. Explicit-English dual-source run passed twice: first channel creation 66/68 ms, reused 15/3 microseconds; both sources returned the exact fixture text.

items.changes: Analyzer, result consumer and finalization now honor the shared interactive priority mapping.
items.remaining: Native timing requires installed SpeechAnalyzer assets; no performance claim.
items.validation: Priority propagation regression passed. Installed-language discovery returned English but channel preparation reported missing SpeechAnalyzer assets; no assets were installed for this benchmark.

items.changes: Retain bounded exact input tokenization and explicit text lifetimes. Native ChatSession experiment removed.
items.validation: Qwen3.5 2B native session correctly fell back to full prefill: its template removes the empty thinking block for historical replies, requiring rewind unsupported by its recurrent cache. Three reused/rebuilt pairs returned violet-42 but reused zero of 872 prompt tokens. No template or recurrent-state workarounds retained. Exact-token-count check matched across 20 repeated budget measurements; native decorator self-check covers changed content/template context and cancellation.

items.changes: Shared inference lifetime, pressure-aware text retention, revision-aware identity, registry owns helper expiry.
items.validation: Retention/end-of-lifetime/pressure eviction test and existing preemption tests pass.

items.changes: Fixed sample-rate catalog hint permits device preparation concurrently with model/text work; stop and echo-reference lifetime unchanged.
items.validation: 18 focused tests completed, including silent real-hardware render-clock, short-utterance echo reference and stopped-output checks.
items.decision: No persistent idle engine: move preparation off first-PCM delivery without adding device/echo producers between replies.

items.changes: Selected voice conversion only; verified binaries bypass conversion. Source/version-keyed derived cache validates output digest and bounds.
items.validation: Cache corruption/replacement/symlink tests, packaged binary/JSON regression, offline native voice switching, and three paired same-fixture runs.

items.changes: Provider-declared complete drafts can finalize identical audio without another prediction; incremental providers still flush. Whisper dictionary tokenization is cached per loaded tokenizer.
items.validation: Integration test confirms one decode for identical complete-window finalization and two for flush-required engines; dictionary tests cover repeat/change/clear and Unicode. Two native Parakeet turns returned the fixture transcript; finalization 46/57 ms. Whisper weights unavailable; tokenizer cache validated with injected encoder.
items.decision: Keep partial cadence unchanged: no recognition-quality evidence supports reducing draft work further.

items.changes: One exact committed native continuation owned by stable backend; turn-local tool router; discard after errors, tool-result turns, edits, compaction, lifetime end and memory pressure.
items.validation: Application adapter native comparison returned violet-42 in all six calls. Failure, exact-history and pressure tests passed; tool-routing regression added. Full suite includes current-toolbox routing, late-call rejection and rebuilding after a tool result.

items.finding: Pinned native API provides utterance indices but no utterance completion signal, and queues output without bounded backpressure. Removing finish alone would break the phrase request protocol.
items.decision: Keep bounded per-phrase completion. Existing voice snapshots avoid repeating neural voice prefill. A native end-of-utterance event and bounded frame delivery are prerequisites for a persistent session; no timing-gap heuristic.
items.validation: Offline native profile plus change-voice/change-back completed with valid audio. Language matching inspected in the pinned runtime; multilingual audio quality was not assessed.

items.finding: Adapter and pinned runtime already cache and match voice/language prompts.
items.validation: Offline native profile plus change-voice/change-back completed with valid audio. Language matching inspected in the pinned runtime; multilingual audio quality was not assessed.
items.decision: Pinned runtime already matches voice, language and instruction before using its prompt cache; no extra cache added.

items.finding: Native V3 pipeline returns the learned alignment/vocoder output directly (frames * 600 samples), without adapter-inserted leading padding. The fixture has nonzero samples before the audibility threshold is crossed.
items.decision: Preserve waveform. A low-amplitude threshold is not proof that initial phonemes can be removed; no clipping or shortening of model output.
